第一千六百六十二章指导（下）
萧叶对于自己的修为和实力，所需要的就是沉淀，容不得着急。
如今他的修为，在整个法象境内都已经算是不败的存在，也用不着那般的着急。
距离前往不周灵山期间，他基本上都是在指点三个孩子，或是宗门弟子。
他是圣子，但是不知道是谁，给他冠名了一个宗门大师兄的称号，这下可好，最为大师兄的他总不能白嫖俸禄吧。
毕竟在很多的宗门中，都是大师兄帮师傅指导的。
“看着他那么闲就来气。”秋妙璇看着萧叶的身影说道，可见，这个大师兄的称呼就是她个按上去的。
“这不好吧，好歹老大他还给我们那么的修炼资源，还指导我们，这么坑他是不是不太好？”阿飞看着秋妙璇说道，他现在完全就是在给秋妙璇打下手。
“这是他应该做的，对了，阿良呢，又死哪儿偷懒去了？”秋妙璇四处张望，寻找着袁秋良那肥胖的身影。
“别找了，写小黄书编排老大被发现了，现在应该还在床上躺着呢。”
“会不会直接断更啊？”
“不清楚，除非他为了大义而献身。”
“放心吧，有我在他死不了的，最起码在他写完以前是绝对不会死的。”说话之人是小青，因为萧叶离开没有带上她，这三个多月的时间，在道宗完全沾染上了一些陋习，再也不是曾经那个......算了，这丫头的脾气本身就不好，尤其是对萧叶的。
作为一个法象境强者，萧叶对于法则的参悟，还真的担当的其这个责任。尤其是对那些序列首席，有着诸多的帮助。
看着眼前的序列，曾经的北洲大陆的宗门除去影神殿，七大宗门加在一起，外加圣子圣女，足足有着七十多个。可经历了战争以后，加上一些因为身份原因没有加入道宗的，在这里的只有二十多人了。
最严重的就是原阴灵宗，基本上全灭，只有一个序列活着离开了。
原赤霄宗算是好的了，只有少量的几人陨落，其余的都存活了下来。另外的五个宗门，都是损失严重。
这些序列的实力天赋都不差，又吃到了战争以后的天地反哺，最差的也来到了通神境，优秀的已经来到了踏天境。
看着一众序列当中，那格格不入的五彩斑斓的彩龙，在一群人形当中显得有些格格不入。
“我说小彩，你就不能像碧月灵蛟一样化作人形吗？”萧叶说道。

“主人不行啊，你让我当什么镇宗神兽，炼化了那气运以后，我短时间内是无法化作人形，只能够以这幅身体行动。而且，我已经把体积缩得够小了，我原本就是蛇，这么小合适了，总不能让我成为泥鳅吧。”彩云说道，小小的身体游动，宛若是一条彩带。
“罢了罢了。我不会有任何的留手，你们所有人一起上，先让我看看你们现在的修为实力。我没有什么大道理会讲，只能通过战斗来指点出你们的不足之处。”萧叶说道，依旧是用训练孩子们的方式。
一众序列可没有三个孩子那么的兴奋，相互之间对视一样，真的不会把山门给打碎吗？
但他们想的有些多了，为了避免这种情况。
在上方星辰当中闭关的太上长老们可没有闲着，利用天地规则，还有各种阵法压制着宗门的天地。他们的动静再怎么的大，威力还在，但是破坏力可就缩小了很多。
基本上所有的势力都是如此，不是位高权重就没有事情干，这就是其中一项工作。
战斗一触即发，萧叶并没有在第一时间压制所有人，不是他不想，而是他根本就没有做到。
在场的所有人都清楚他的修为实力，比起几个月前之强而不弱。
可以说，当萧叶说出要和众人切磋的时候，在场的所有的序列就已经开始准备了。这让萧叶很是认同，提前准备，出其不意，这才像话。
阵法协同，使其战力大幅度的增长，萧叶想要拿下都不是一件容易的事情。
甚至于....他都不见得能够拿下。

Chapter 1,662 Guidance (Part 2)
What Xiao Ye needs for his cultivation and strength is precipitation, and there is no room for anxiety.
Now that his cultivation is considered undefeated in the entire Dharmaxiang territory, there is no need to be so anxious.
During the time he went to Buzhou Lingshan, he basically tutored three children or sect disciples.
He is the Holy Son, but I don't know who gave him the title of eldest brother of the sect. This is great. As the eldest brother, he can't spend his salary in vain.
After all, in many sects, it is the senior brother who helps guide the master.
"It makes me angry to see him so idle." Qiu Miaoxuan said looking at Xiao Ye's figure. It can be seen that she was the one who named this senior brother.
"Isn't that bad? After all, the boss has given us such training resources and guided us. Isn't it bad to trick him like this?" A Fei looked at Qiu Miaoxuan and said. He was now completely undermining Qiu Miaoxuan.
"This is what he should do. By the way, where is A Liang, where are you lazying?" Qiu Miaoxuan looked around, looking for Yuan Qiuliang's fat figure.
"Stop looking. The boss who wrote pornographic books has been found. He should still be lying on the bed now."
"Will it be discontinued immediately?"
"I don't know, unless he sacrifices his life for the cause of justice."
"Don't worry, he can't die with me, at least he won't die before he finishes writing." The person who spoke was Xiao Qing, because Xiao Ye left without taking her with her. In the past three months, she had completely contracted some bad habits in Daozong, and she was no longer the same as before... Forget it, this girl's temper itself is not good, especially towards Xiao Ye.
As a strong person in the Dharma Realm, Xiao Ye really shouldered this responsibility in his understanding of the laws. Especially for those sequence chiefs, it has a lot of help.
Looking at the sequence in front of me, excluding the Shadow Temple, there were more than seventy sects in the former Beizhou Continent, including the seven major sects, plus saints and saints. But after the war, and some people who did not join the Dao Sect due to their status, there were only about twenty people here.
The most serious one was the original Yin Ling Sect, which was basically wiped out, with only one sequence left alive.
The original Scarlet Sky Sect was considered to be in good condition, only a few people died, and the rest survived. The other five sects all suffered serious losses.
The strength and talent of these sequences are not bad, and they have received feedback from the world after the war. The worst ones have reached the realm of gods, and the outstanding ones have reached the realm of stepping on the sky.
Looking at the sequence, the colorful dragon seemed out of place among a group of human figures.
"Xiao Cai, can't you transform into a human form like the Biyue Lingjiao?" Xiao Ye said.
"Master, I can't do it. What kind of sect-suppressing beast do you want me to be? After refining that luck, I won't be able to transform into a human form for a short period of time. I can only move with this body. Moreover, I have shrunk my size to a small enough size. I was originally a snake. I am so small and suitable. You can't let me become a loach." Caiyun said, and his small body swam like a ribbon.
"That's all. I won't hold anything back. All of you come together and let me see your current cultivation strength first. I don't have any great principles. I can only point out your shortcomings through fighting." Xiao Ye said, still using the method of training children.
The whole group was not as excited as the three children. They looked at each other. Wouldn't they really break the mountain gate?
But they thought too much in order to avoid this situation.
The Supreme Elders who were in seclusion among the stars above were not idle. They used the rules of heaven and earth and various formations to suppress the world of the sect. No matter how loud their movements are, their power is still there, but their destructive power has been greatly reduced.
basicallyThis is true for all forces. If you don't have a high position, there will be nothing to do. This is one of the tasks.
The battle was about to break out, and Xiao Ye did not suppress everyone immediately. It was not that he didn't want to, but that he simply failed to do it.
Everyone present knew that his cultivation strength was stronger than a few months ago.
It can be said that when Xiao Ye said that he wanted to compete with everyone, all the sequences present had already started to prepare. This made Xiao Ye agree very much. It was only reasonable to prepare in advance and take things by surprise.
The formation synergy greatly increased its combat power, and it was not easy for Xiao Ye to win.
Even...he may not be able to win it.
